classification_detail: request-deterministic (bitwise-identical request bytes and rendered prompt) but response text nondeterministic; the nondeterminism originates in model execution on the pinned runtime's default multithreaded repacked CPU kernels; it is configuration-dependent (vanishes with 1 thread or without repack) but those configurations are NOT the frozen release runtime and were used for diagnosis only

layer_findings.A_request_construction: NOT RESPONSIBLE: one request sha per path across all trials (TEST D)
layer_findings.B_template_rendering: NOT RESPONSIBLE: harness rendering reproduces Ollama's token count (79) and the direct llama-server path yields the same output set as Ollama (525d757d, f6dc9f01, ...)
layer_findings.C_application_state: NOT RESPONSIBLE: harness is replay-deterministic offline (identical responses -> identical ledger hash, tests/test_rc2_reproducibility.py)
layer_findings.D_process_state: CONTRIBUTES ONLY AS A CARRIER: within one process repeated outputs usually agree (TEST A 5/5), but fresh processes differ (TEST B 3 distinct first outputs in 5)
layer_findings.E_server_state_prompt_cache: NOT THE CAUSE: with cache_prompt=false on an isolated llama-server (TEST C) outputs still vary (and C_fa_off: 3 distinct in 12)
layer_findings.F_runtime_configuration: CONTROLS IT: -t 1 (single thread) -> 1 distinct in 12 across 6 processes; --no-repack (8 threads) -> 1 distinct in 12 across 6 processes; default (8 threads, repacked AMX/AVX-512 weights) -> multiple distinct
layer_findings.G_model_execution: ROOT CAUSE: multithreaded execution of the repacked CPU matmul kernels is not bitwise reproducible; greedy decoding (top_k 1) flips at near-tied logits
layer_findings.H_recorder_ledger: BUG FOUND (secondary): RC1 response_hash hashed the raw HTTP body, which includes created_at and duration fields, so it can never match across runs even when text matches; fixed generically in RC2 by recording content_sha256 separately from raw_body_sha256
